blocks.title: One River Point — Location
blocks.text: One River Point — Location One River Point is nestled in Dubai’s “Manhattan”, within the Business Bay neighborhood. Conveniently close to the UAE's main transportation artery, Sheikh Zayed Road, which is merely a two-minute drive away. The Business Bay metro station is reachable within a five-minute drive. 1 min Dubai Water Canal Boardwalk 2 min Dubai Waterfall 5 min Business Bay Marina 5 min Al Quoz Pond Park 7 min

blocks.title: One River Point — About the project
headings: One River Point — About the project
blocks.text: One River Point — About the project One River Point stands tall with 37 residential floors and a five-story podium. It offers designer studios with balconies, 1-3 bedroom apartments, terraced duplexes, and spacious 3-4 bedroom penthouses. Apartments range from 1,060.25 to 2,397.3 square feet, while duplexes and penthouses span from 3,502 to 5,847 square feet.
